25 def baseline(work_dir: str, model=None):
26     """
27     The workflow of the baseline mode.
28     :return:
29     """
30 
31     console = Console()
32     cache = WorkflowCache(work_dir, 'baseline')
33     model = load_model(work_dir, model)
34 
35     if not cache.is_empty():
36         step = ask_text(f"MLE has finished the following steps: \n{cache}\n"
37                         f"You can pick a step from 1 to {cache.current_step()} to resume\n"
38                         "(or ENTER to continue the workflow)")
39         if step:
40             step = int(step)
41             for i in range(step, cache.current_step() + 1):
42                 cache.remove(i)  # remove the stale step caches
43 
44     # ask for the data information
45     with cache(step=1, name="ask for the data information") as ca:
46         dataset = ca.resume("dataset")
47         if dataset is None:
48             advisor = AdviseAgent(model, console)
49             dataset = ask_text("Please provide your dataset information (a public dataset name or a local file path)")
50             if not dataset:
51                 print_in_box("The dataset is empty. Aborted", console, title="Error", color="red")
52                 return
53             dataset = advisor.clarify_dataset(dataset)
54             ca.store("dataset", dataset)
55 
56     # ask for the user requirement
57     with cache(step=2, name="ask for the user requirement") as ca:
58         ml_requirement = ca.resume("ml_requirement")
59         if ml_requirement is None:
60             ml_requirement = ask_text("Please provide your requirement")
61             if not ml_requirement:
62                 print_in_box("The user's requirement is empty. Aborted", console, title="Error", color="red")
63                 return
64         ca.store("ml_requirement", ml_requirement)
65 
66     # advisor agent gives suggestions in a report
67     with cache(step=3, name="MLE advisor agent provides a high-level report") as ca:
68         advisor_report = ca.resume("advisor_report")
69         if advisor_report is None:
70             advisor = AdviseAgent(model, console)
71             advisor_report = advisor.interact("[green]User Requirement:[/green] " + ml_requirement + "\n" + ask_data(dataset))
72         ca.store("advisor_report", advisor_report)
73 
74     # plan agent generates the coding plan
75     with cache(step=4, name="MLE plan agent generates a dev plan") as ca:
76         coding_plan = ca.resume("coding_plan")
77         if coding_plan is None:
78             planner = PlanAgent(model, console)
79             coding_plan = planner.interact(advisor_report)
80         ca.store("coding_plan", coding_plan)
81 
82     # code agent codes the tasks and debug with the debug agent
83     with cache(step=5, name="MLE code&debug agents start to work") as ca:
84         coder = CodeAgent(model, work_dir, console)
85         coder.read_requirement(advisor_report)
86         debugger = DebugAgent(model, console)
87 
88         is_auto_mode = questionary.confirm(
89             "MLE developer is about to start to code.\n"
90             "Choose to debug or not (If no, MLE agent will only focus on coding tasks,"
91             " and you have to run and debug the code yourself)?"
92         ).ask()
93 
94         for current_task in coding_plan.get('tasks'):
95             code_report = coder.interact(current_task)
96             is_debugging = code_report.get('debug')
97 
98             if is_auto_mode:
99                 while True:
100                     if is_debugging == 'true' or is_debugging == 'True':
101                         with console.status("MLE Debug Agent is executing and debugging the code..."):
102                             debug_report = debugger.analyze(code_report)
103                         if debug_report.get('status') == 'success':
104                             break
105                         else:
106                             code_report = coder.debug(current_task, debug_report)
107                     else:
108                         break
intended_behavior: Extend the baseline workflow to establish a workdir for local code scanning. Implement embedding generation of scanned code using an embedding model (starting with OpenAI) and persist these embeddings using the Memory class. This integration should preserve all existing interactions, cached steps, and agent workflows.

14 class Memory:
15     def __init__(
16             self,
17             project_path: str,
18             embedding_model: str = "text-embedding-ada-002"
19     ):
20         """
21         Memory: memory and external knowledge management.
22         Args:
23             project_path: the path to store the data.
24             embedding_model: the embedding model to use, default will use the embedding model from ChromaDB,
25              if the OpenAI has been set in the configuration, it will use the OpenAI embedding model
26              "text-embedding-ada-002".
27         """
28         self.db_name = '.mle'
29         self.collection_name = 'memory'
30         self.client = chromadb.PersistentClient(path=os.path.join(project_path, self.db_name))
31 
32         config = get_config(project_path)
33         # use the OpenAI embedding function if the openai section is set in the configuration.
34         if config['platform'] == 'OpenAI':
35             self.client.get_or_create_collection(
36                 self.collection_name,
37                 embedding_function=embedding_functions.OpenAIEmbeddingFunction(
38                     model_name=embedding_model,
39                     api_key=config['api_key']
40                 )
41             )
42         else:
43             self.client.get_or_create_collection(self.collection_name)
44 
45     def add_query(
46             self,
47             queries: List[Dict[str, str]],
48             collection: str = None,
49             idx: List[str] = None
50     ):
51         """
52         add_query: add the queries to the memery.
53         Args:
54             queries: the queries to add to the memery. Should be in the format of
55                 {
56                     "query": "the query",
57                     "response": "the response"
58                 }
59             collection: the name of the collection to add the queries.
60             idx: the ids of the queries, should be in the same length as the queries.
61             If not provided, the ids will be generated by UUID.
62 
63         Return: A list of generated IDs.
64         """
65         if idx:
66             ids = idx
67         else:
68             ids = [str(uuid.uuid4()) for _ in range(len(queries))]
69 
70         if not collection:
71             collection = self.collection_name
72 
73         query_list = [query['query'] for query in queries]
74         added_time = datetime.now().isoformat()
75         resp_list = [{'response': query['response'], 'created_at': added_time} for query in queries]
76         # insert the record into the database
77         self.client.get_or_create_collection(collection).add(
78             documents=query_list,
79             metadatas=resp_list,
80             ids=ids
81         )
82 
83         return ids
84 
85     def query(self, query_texts: List[str], collection: str = None, n_results: int = 5):
86         """
87         query: query the memery.
88         Args:
89             query_texts: the query texts to search in the memery.
90             collection: the name of the collection to search.
91             n_results: the number of results to return.
92 
93         Returns: the top k results.
94         """
95         if not collection:
96             collection = self.collection_name
97         return self.client.get_or_create_collection(collection).query(query_texts=query_texts, n_results=n_results)
98 
99     def peek(self, collection: str = None, n_results: int = 20):
100         """
101         peek: peek the memery.
102         Args:
103             collection: the name of the collection to peek.
104             n_results: the number of results to return.
105 
106         Returns: the top k results.
107         """
108         if not collection:
109             collection = self.collection_name
110         return self.client.get_or_create_collection(collection).peek(limit=n_results)
111 
112     def get(self, collection: str = None, record_id: str = None):
113         """
114         get: get the record by the id.
115         Args:
116             record_id: the id of the record.
117             collection: the name of the collection to get the record.
118 
119         Returns: the record.
120         """
121         if not collection:
122             collection = self.collection_name
123         collection = self.client.get_collection(collection)
124         if not record_id:
125             return collection.get()
126 
127         return collection.get(record_id)
128 
129     def delete(self, collection_name=None):
130         """
131         delete: delete the memery collections.
132         Args:
133             collection_name: the name of the collection to delete.
134         """
135         if not collection_name:
136             collection_name = self.collection_name
137         return self.client.delete_collection(name=collection_name)
138 
139     def count(self, collection_name=None):
140         """
141         count: count the number of records in the memery.
142         Args:
143             collection_name: the name of the collection to count.
144         """
145         if not collection_name:
146             collection_name = self.collection_name
147         return self.client.get_collection(name=collection_name).count()
148 
149     def reset(self):
150         """
151         reset: reset the memory.
152         Notice: You may need to set the environment variable `ALLOW_RESET` to `TRUE` to enable this function.
153         """
154         self.client.reset()
